datatype.name: LegCount
datatype.definition: A non-negative count of legs in an organism's typical adult body plan.

concept.name: Animal
concept.definition: A multicellular eukaryotic organism of the kingdom Animalia.

property.name: legCount
property.definition: Number of legs in the organism's typical adult body plan.

provenance.note: Structural trait; per-taxon values are sourced at L2.

concept.name: Human
concept.definition: A member of the species Homo sapiens. The intermediate biological ranks (Chordate, Mammal, Primate, …) are carried as `classified_as` facts rather than as inheritance levels, so the code hierarchy stays shallow [INV-3].

provenance.note: Legal/social person is a separate role, not biology.

property.name: fullName
property.definition: The person's full personal name as used for identification.

property.name: dateOfBirth
property.definition: The calendar date on which the person was born.

concept.name: AnatomicalStructure
concept.definition: A connected biological structure with inherent 3-D shape, generated by the coordinated expression of an organism's own genome; a material part of a body.

provenance.source: Foundational Model of Anatomy (FMA), Rosse C & Mejino JLV, J Biomed Inform 36(6):478-500, 2003
Uberon multi-species anatomy ontology (Mungall CJ et al., Genome Biology 2012;13:R5; PMID 22293552)

concept.name: Organ
concept.definition: A self-contained anatomical structure, composed of several tissue types, that performs a specific function or set of functions in the body.

provenance.source: Uberon multi-species anatomy ontology (Mungall CJ et al., Genome Biology 2012;13:R5; PMID 22293552)

concept.name: OrganSystem
concept.definition: A group of organs that work together to carry out one or more major body functions. An L0 Collection (a many-as-one) with its own identity.

provenance.source: Uberon multi-species anatomy ontology (Mungall CJ et al., Genome Biology 2012;13:R5; PMID 22293552)
OpenStax, Anatomy and Physiology 2e, 2022, §1.2 'Structural Organization of the Human Body'
provenance.note: The human body is commonly described as eleven organ systems.

concept.name: Heart
concept.definition: The muscular organ that pumps blood through the cardiovascular system; part of the cardiovascular system.

concept.name: Brain
concept.definition: The central organ of the nervous system, situated within the cranium in vertebrates; part of the nervous system.

concept.name: Lung
concept.definition: The respiration organ in which gas exchange between air and blood takes place; part of the respiratory system.

concept.name: Liver
concept.definition: The large exocrine gland that secretes bile and carries out metabolism, detoxification and storage functions; part of the digestive system.

concept.name: Kidney
concept.definition: A paired organ of the urinary tract that produces urine and maintains fluid, electrolyte and acid-base homeostasis; part of the urinary system.

concept.name: Stomach
concept.definition: An expanded region of the alimentary tract that stores and begins digesting food; part of the digestive system.

individual.name: CardiovascularSystem
individual.definition: The system of heart and blood vessels that circulates blood around the body.

individual.name: NervousSystem
individual.definition: The system of brain, spinal cord and nerves that detects stimuli and coordinates responses.

individual.name: RespiratorySystem
individual.definition: The system of airways and lungs that takes in oxygen and expels carbon dioxide.

individual.name: DigestiveSystem
individual.definition: The system that ingests, breaks down and absorbs food and eliminates waste.

individual.name: UrinarySystem
individual.definition: The system of kidneys and urinary tract that filters blood and excretes urine.
